| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Detail range sigma r** `sigmaR` | 0.3 | 0.01 to 1 | Brightness differences up to this size, on a scale from 0 to 1, count as detail, and larger ones as edges. 0.3 as in Figure 7 of Paris et al. |
| **Detail power alpha** `alpha` | 0.5 | 0.1 to 4 | The power of f_d(x) = x^alpha. Below 1, details grow, and above 1 they shrink. Our choice of 0.5. |
| **Edge factor beta** `beta` | 1 | 0 to 2 | The factor of f_e(a) = beta a. Below 1, edges are compressed. Paris et al. use 1 for detail manipulation. |
| **Brightness samples** `samples` | 16 | 4 to 64 | How many values of g the fast algorithm samples from 0 to 1. Our choice of 16. On a small test image it came within 39 dB of the exact algorithm. |
